{{Top|leg}}
The '''K'kybak''' were a sentient [[Species/Legends|species]] who lived millions of years before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Seymarti V]], and were responsible for creating the [[hyperspace nullifier]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]]. Eventually the species became extinct.<ref name="Honor Among Thieves">[[Honor Among Thieves]]</ref>
